title: Pan-Fried Egg with Toast
description: A simple Chinese-inspired breakfast dish made with a fried egg, crispy toast, and a touch of savory flavor.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Crack in the egg and cook until the whites are set.
Meanwhile, toast the bread until crispy.
Once the egg is cooked, remove it from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the soy sauce, ginger, and green onions.
Stir to combine and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the egg on top of the toast, drizzled with the savory sauce.
